description.value: JOEY is a family-owned upscale casual dining chain operating since 1992, with locations across Canada and the US. Each restaurant is custom-built with a distinct design and serves a globally inspired menu of handcrafted dishes and cocktails developed by a team of Executive Chefs. The Kelowna outpost sits along Highway 97, making it a recognizable stop on one of the Okanagan's main cycling corridors.
